_meta.status: ACTIVE runtime persona fleet (M6b Scope C, 02.11.2026). Switched from the legacy 3-persona gift fleet onto the signed-off v2.1 concept fleet.
_meta.schema: FLAT (M6b loader-fix): matcher keys sit DIRECTLY on the effect row (internalNameMatch/factionMatch/multiplier/guardPercent/patterns/amount), no nested 'filter' object, amount never 'count'. Core/Personas.cs is the only schema reading; PersonasGate fails the build on a nested row.
_meta.channels: v2.1 four-channel ridge: pattern_weight | guard_split | signaturText | elite_swap. Gifts (free_deployment/cost_reduction) are a build error - missions are hard-balanced (Beschluss 11 Delta-0).
_meta.elite_swap_law: engine books the REGULAR's printed cost; elite_card is the explicit card-id target (never a name guess); max one swap per figure name per mission; no swap while an elite print of the name is on the board (start groups and Hard-Mode products count in defensively).
_meta.ui_keys: nameKey/mottoKey/signatur keys land in ui.json with M6c; until then PersonaState.DisplayName falls back to the raw persona id (null-safe).
